_comment: What asset.check --strict does with a WARNING row (satk.style.check.strict_status): a warning is a real flaw at
the place given that vanilla models of the class show too. Above the limit here (calibrated on every vanilla
vehicle, 300 map objects, the weapons, peds, time and animated objects: about 9 in 10 vanilla models of a family
stay below it, and every kit kind's exemplar) it blocks; at or below it, or marked advice, it is listed under
'advice' (fix it in the polish, it does not block). Defects, engine errors and missing checklist items always
block; a warning of a check not named here always blocks. Merged default <- family <- parent classes <- class.
over: the row's value (form.floating mm, mesh.zfight cm2, mesh.crack mm of seam, mesh.normals share, mesh.flipped cm2, mesh.degenerate triangles, mesh.inside_out m3, col.outside m,
col.uncovered share); width_over: mesh.crack seam width (mm); self: the overlap of one part with itself (decals, double cards); advice: never blocks.
under: a share where less is worse (lod.silhouette: the HD outline the LOD covers).
